about: Rules of the Applications page: which programs are unsafe or unwanted. Patterns are Python regular expressions matched on the lower-case program name; dates are the end of security support.
end_of_life: Adobe Flash Player is dead since 2020 and full of known holes.
Microsoft Silverlight left support in October 2021.
QuickTime for Windows gets no fixes since 2016 and has known holes.
Skype was retired in May 2025: Microsoft Teams replaced it.
Windows Essentials (Live Mail, Movie Maker) left support in 2017.
This Adobe Reader or Acrobat version gets no security fixes.
Java 7 and older get no security fixes.
Office 2016 and 2019 left support in October 2025: no more security fixes.
Office 2021 left support in October 2026: no more security fixes.
.NET Core 3.1 and older get no security fixes.
min_versions: WinRAR before 7.13 can be taken over by a booby-trapped archive (CVE-2025-8088, used in real attacks).
7-Zip before 25.01 can write files outside the folder when extracting a crafted archive (CVE-2025-0411, CVE-2025-55188).
VLC before 3.0.21 can run code from a crafted video file.
PuTTY before 0.81 can leak your private SSH key (CVE-2024-31497).
